retailer_description"Annie's Organic Vegan Mac Shells and Sweet Potato Pumpkin makes it easy to get a kid-approved side on the table in minutes. Ideal for the vegan pasta and sauce lovers in your household, each deliciously creamy serving is non-GMO and certified USDA Organic for the goodness you'd expect from Annie's. Reach for a warm, comforting portion as a convenient vegan snack, or a tasty part of lunch or dinner. Or serve some paired with vegan chicken nuggets or as a side dish to any meal. About two and a half servings per container. Annie's makes products in over 20 family-friendly categories, from fruit flavored snacks and cereal to mac and cheese. For busy bunnies and families on the go, we help make life a little easier and more delicious by spreading goodness through tasty foods and kindness to the planet. Contains Annie's Organic Vegan Mac Shells and Sweet Potato Pumpkin, Pasta and Sauce, 6 oz; shelf-stable dried mix."

retailer_description"One step. Three acids. Results that build. Andalou's Resurfacing Triple Acid Exfoliating Toner is a milky, leave-on 5% AHA toner that addresses texture, pore appearance, and the look of dark spots all at once — because your skin deserves more than a single-acid solution. Powered by Fruit Science™, glycolic, lactic, and mandelic acids each do a different job: glycolic exfoliates at the surface, lactic smooths and supports hydration, mandelic gently addresses uneven tone. Niacinamide visibly refines pore appearance while pineapple and papaya enzymes lift dull surface buildup. The result is skin that looks smoother, more even-toned, and visibly refreshed — no rinsing required. Rooted in renewal and refined by science — at Andalou, our patented Fruit Science™ innovation is clinically proven to support skin's natural wisdom. We don't fight change. We formulate for it. Suitable for sensitive skin. Dermatologist tested. Begin 1–2 uses weekly, increasing to daily as tolerated. Sunburn Alert: This product contains alpha hydroxy acids (AHAs). Apply a broad-spectrum sunscreen daily while using this product and for one week after. AHAs may increase skin's sensitivity to sun exposure. Formulated without parabens, sulfates, phthalates, or other harmful additives. Cruelty free."

retailer_description"Annie's Frozen Uncured Pepperoni Mini Pizza Bagels combine delicious cheese, zesty tomato sauce and savory uncured pepperoni for a crunchy bagel snack! Enjoy bite-sized mini bagels made with cheese, organic flour, and tomatoes. This snack contains no artificial flavors or synthetic colors, and no nitrates or nitrites added*. These mini pizza bagels are made with whole grains. Simply take some out of the freezer and put them in the oven, toaster oven, or microwave. In just a few minutes, you'll have delicious bites that'll be a hit with the whole household! Perfect for busy families, they make a great snack, addition to lunch, or appetizers before dinner. You'll love how easy they are to heat and enjoy! Annie's makes products in over 20 family-friendly categories, from fruit flavored snacks and cereal to mac and cheese. For busy bunnies and families on the go, we help make life a little easier and more delicious by spreading goodness through tasty foods and kindness to the planet. *Except those naturally occurring in cultured celery juice powder and sea salt. See nutrition information for sodium content."

retailer_description"Annie's Organic Vegan Mac Shells and Sweet Potato Pumpkin makes it easy to get a kid-approved side on the table in minutes. retailer_description"Think all bar soaps are created equal? Then let us change your mind with the All-One Hemp Citrus Orange Pure-Castile Bar Soap from Dr. Bronner’s. Unlike most bar soaps, this one is made with certified fair-trade ingredients and organic U.S.-grown hemp oil in order to provide a soft and luxurious lather that will not dry skin. It is 100% biodegradable and contains only all-natural, vegan ingredients that are environmentally-friendly, gentle and mild for safe and effective use on your face, body or hair. You can count on the bar soap to create a rich lather with every use while keeping skin smooth and soft, especially thanks to the inclusion of the purest certified organic oils. You’ll find it is completely free of any chelating agents, dyes, whiteners, synthetic fragrances, synthetic preservatives, thickeners or foaming agents. And we promise the bar soap smells just as good as it treats your skin and the environment, coming in a refreshing citrus medley of organic orange, lemon and lime oils. The All-One Hemp Citrus Orange Pure-Castile Bar Soap from Dr. Bronner’s comes in a five-ounce size and packaged in a 100% post-consumer recycled wrapper, and includes cruelty-free ingredients never tested on animals. You won’t find a better way to get clean!"

retailer_description"Think all bar soaps are created equal? Then let us change your mind with the All-One Hemp Citrus Orange Pure-Castile Bar Soap from Dr. Bronner’s. Unlike most bar soaps, this one is made with certified fair-trade ingredients and organic U.S.-grown hemp oil in order to provide a soft and luxurious lather that will not dry skin. It is 100% biodegradable and contains only all-natural, vegan ingredients that are environmentally-friendly, gentle and mild for safe and effective use on your face, body or hair. You can count on the bar soap to create a rich lather with every use while keeping skin smooth and soft, especially thanks to the inclusion of the purest certified organic oils. You’ll find it is completely free of any chelating agents, dyes, whiteners, synthetic fragrances, synthetic preservatives, thickeners or foaming agents. And we promise the bar soap smells just as good as it treats your skin and the environment, coming in a refreshing citrus medley of organic orange, lemon and lime oils. The All-One Hemp Citrus Orange Pure-Castile Bar Soap from Dr. Bronner’s comes in a five-ounce size and packaged in a 100% post-consumer recycled wrapper, and includes cruelty-free ingredients never tested on animals. You won’t find a better way to get clean!"

retailer_description"Annie's Frozen Uncured Pepperoni Mini Pizza Bagels combine delicious cheese, zesty tomato sauce and savory uncured pepperoni for a crunchy bagel snack! Enjoy bite-sized mini bagels made with cheese, organic flour, and tomatoes. This snack contains no artificial flavors or synthetic colors, and no nitrates or nitrites added*. These mini pizza bagels are made with whole grains. Simply take some out of the freezer and put them in the oven, toaster oven, or microwave. In just a few minutes, you'll have delicious bites that'll be a hit with the whole household! Perfect for busy families, they make a great snack, addition to lunch, or appetizers before dinner. You'll love how easy they are to heat and enjoy! Annie's makes products in over 20 family-friendly categories, from fruit flavored snacks and cereal to mac and cheese. For busy bunnies and families on the go, we help make life a little easier and more delicious by spreading goodness through tasty foods and kindness to the planet. *Except those naturally occurring in cultured celery juice powder and sea salt. See nutrition information for sodium content."

retailer_description"Annie's Organic Honey Graham Crackers are a yummy organic snack for snackers of all ages. Made with organic wheat flour and 10 grams of whole grains per serving*, these graham crackers are perfect with lunchtime, afternoon snacks or anytime you need a quick, tasty treat. No artificial flavors or synthetic colors - just certified organic honey flavored crunches of yum. Try 'em plain, topped with nut butter, or in your favorite baking and s'more recipes. Add some joy and hoppiness to your day with Annie's - snacks made with goodness. Annie's makes products in over 20 family-friendly categories, from fruit-flavored snacks and cereal to mac and cheese. For busy bunnies and families on the go, we help make life a little easier and more delicious by spreading goodness through tasty foods and kindness to the planet. *10g whole grain per serving. At least 48g recommended daily."

retailer_description"Looking to reduce your plastic packaging use? Now you can refill your Shampoo & Wash bottle with our 32 oz Refill Pouch, which uses 80% less plastic than two 16 oz bottles! Make bath time fun with Sensitive Baby Fragrance-Free 2-in-1 Baby Shampoo & Wash. Created for babies and kiddos with sensitive skin, this mild cleanser is enriched with sustainably sourced nourishing shea butter and comes in a 30% post-consumer recycled refill pouch. Made with 23 plant-based ingredients such as oat, cocoa butter and aloe vera. Perfect for daily use even on the most delicate skin. This gentle formula is EWG Verified™ and fragrance free to ensure the highest level of safety and quality. Light and airy, this baby shampoo & wash rinses clean and leaves skin and hair feeling extra soft and moisturized. Our sustainably sourced Shea Butter supports village farmers in highlands of Guinea."

retailer_description"Experience ultimate skin nourishment and relief with Badger Organic Aloe Vera Gel for Face & Body, an ancient remedy renowned for its healing properties. Our aloe vera gel is not just certified fair trade but also designed to provide cooling, soothing comfort, making it the perfect after sun lotion for those hot summer days. Whether you're looking to soothe sunburn relief or simply maintain everyday skin vitality, this non-sticky aloe gel works like magic on your face and body. Hypoallergenic and unscented, its an ideal choice for those who value simplicity in beauty care without compromising effectiveness. Why is this 96% and not 100% pure aloe vera gel? Because 100 percent pure aloe gel would need to be refrigerated and would only last as long as fresh juice does. We use a few simple safe ingredient to preserve and stabilize our aloe. Any product claiming to be 100% aloe is misleading, unless it's literally a plant. Used as part of your daily routine or as critical after sun care, this vegan-friendly gel glides on smoothly without leaving any sticky residue behind. Convenience meets competence with Badger Organic Aloe Vera Gel ideal for both travelers and homebodies alike. Experience holistic skincare whether at home or away by incorporating our aloe vera lotion into your regimen today—it doubles as an excellent base under makeup or as a calming night cream replacement. Full Ingredient Lists: Organic Aloe , Xanthan Gum (from non-GMO corn), Water (and) Gluconic Acid (and) Sodium Benzoate (from cassia oil and natural fructose sources), Glyceryl Caprylate (from non-GMO plant material), Citric Acid (from non-GMO corn). = Certified Fair Trade. 96% of product."
retailer_ingredients"Organic Aloe† , Xanthan Gum (from non-GMO corn), Water (and) Gluconic Acid (and) Sodium Benzoate (from cassia oil and natural fructose sources), Glyceryl Caprylate (from non-GMO plant material), Citric Acid (from non-GMO corn). † = Certified Fair Trade. 96% of product."

retailer_description"Roll away the pain with Arnicare Roll-On by Boiron. The no-mess applicator, featuring a leak-free design, keeps hands clean and is easy to apply on the go. Powered by Arnica, the quickly absorbed formula delivers relief for muscle pain, stiffness, swelling from injuries, and bruises. Arnicare Roll-On does not contain menthol, camphor, methyl salicylate, or capsaicin, so there’s no traditional strong medicine smell. It’s also free of fragrances, dyes, and parabens. Arnicare Roll-On is available over the counter in a 1. 5 oz tube with metal roller. Also try Arnicare in cream and gel squeeze tubes and topical arthritis pain formula. *Claims based on traditional homeopathic practice, not accepted medical evidence. Not FDA evaluated."

retailer_description"Think all bar soaps are created equal? Then let us change your mind with the All-One Hemp Citrus Orange Pure-Castile Bar Soap from Dr. Bronner’s. Unlike most bar soaps, this one is made with certified fair-trade ingredients and organic U.S.-grown hemp oil in order to provide a soft and luxurious lather that will not dry skin. It is 100% biodegradable and contains only all-natural, vegan ingredients that are environmentally-friendly, gentle and mild for safe and effective use on your face, body or hair. You can count on the bar soap to create a rich lather with every use while keeping skin smooth and soft, especially thanks to the inclusion of the purest certified organic oils. You’ll find it is completely free of any chelating agents, dyes, whiteners, synthetic fragrances, synthetic preservatives, thickeners or foaming agents. And we promise the bar soap smells just as good as it treats your skin and the environment, coming in a refreshing citrus medley of organic orange, lemon and lime oils. The All-One Hemp Citrus Orange Pure-Castile Bar Soap from Dr. Bronner’s comes in a five-ounce size and packaged in a 100% post-consumer recycled wrapper, and includes cruelty-free ingredients never tested on animals. You won’t find a better way to get clean!"

retailer_description"Fresh botanical extracts and energizing plant oils for visibly enhancing & tightening the skin. Formulated with fresh raspberry leaf extract, known for firming the appearance of skin, and hyaluronic acid, which holds moisture. Seaweed, algae, sea buckthorn berry oil, and gotu kola combine to visibly firm/tighten, nourish, and tonify the skin. Described by one customer as: \"deep yoga for skin\", our Sea Algae Serum visibly transforms the appearance of wrinkles and fine lines into silky, smooth, radiant skin. Used consistently it helps soften the look of skin. Bio-fermented kelp, derived by fermentation using lactobacillus, and algae (from US Atlantic waters only) deeply nourish and refresh skin. Ingredients: Water (Aqua), Aloe (Aloe barbadensis) Leaf Juice*, Lavender (Lavandula angustifolia) Hydrosol*, Sodium Hyaluronate (Glycosaminoglycans), Lactobacillus/Kelp Ferment Filtrate, Cetearyl Olivate, Sorbitan Olivate, Hydrolyzed Lupine Protein, Gotu Kola (Centella asiatica) Extract*, Kelp (Ascophyllum nodosum) Extract*, Seaweed (Fucus vesiculosus) Extract*, Raspberry (Rubus idaeus) Leaf Extract, Green Tea (Camellia sinensis) Leaf Extract*, Squalane (from olives), Sodium Benzoate, Gluconolactone, Rosemary (Rosmarinus officinalis) Leaf Extract, Xanthan Gum, Sea Buckthorn (Hippophae rhamnoides) Oil*, Algae Extract, Pullulan, Coenzyme Q10, Lavender (Lavandula angustifolia) Flower Oil*, Tea Tree (Melaleuca alternifolia) Leaf Oil*, Clary Sage (Salvia sclarea) Oil*, Rose Geranium (Pelargonium graveolens) Flower Oil* *ORGANIC How to use: Use alone or as a base layer for cosmetics, sunscreen & moisturizers. retailer_description"These Jarrow Formulas vitamin B12 complex chewable tablets combine 1000 mcg of Methyl B-12 and 400 mcg of Methyl Folate to support cardiovascular health, cellular energy metabolism, and neurologic health.(1) This folate and B12 supplement is made with non-GMO ingredients, remains gluten-free, with no wheat, soybeans, dairy, egg, fish, shellfish, peanuts, tree nuts, or sesame, making it suitable for vegetarians and vegans. Each serving provides you with the active forms of vitamin B-12 and vitamin B9 for DNA and neurotransmitter synthesis, cellular energy production, and healthy brain function.(1) The Pyridoxal-5-Phosphate (P-5-P), the coenzyme form of vitamin B6, helps metabolize proteins and amino acids. This dietary supplement in chewable tablet form helps the recycling of homocysteine to cysteine for heart support.(1) This product fits a daily routine at home or on-the-go, used as a daily vitamin with water by any health enthusiast who may want increased energy. Adults take one chewable tablet once a day. Jarrow Formulas products are carefully crafted to ensure health-conscious individuals get the benefit of each supplement, whether they are busy professionals on-the-go or athletes getting ready for a game."
